issues.description: Same 4-0 Argentina–Bolivia friendly appears twice in pinned source extract with dates 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01, same city, score and competition. Retain both source rows as evidence; the 2026-10-01 candidate is excluded from team-form windows. AFA independently reports the match on 30 Sep. Do not count both.

Pinned CC0 CSV latest match date is 2026-10-06. Later matches before November pilot kickoffs may be missing. Do not assume completeness; disclose stale form or add only individually verified and permitted records in a later revision.
Historical dataset is a maintainer-declared CC0 multi-source compilation, not a federation feed. It requires provenance and anomaly checks; no official-source status is implied.
Source scores include extra time and exclude penalty shootouts. They are not automatically regulation-time scores for model outcome evaluation.
Turkey→Türkiye, Czech Republic→Czechia, Korea Republic/Korea South→South Korea. Original source team names remain preserved; unknown names must not be fuzzy-matched.
